headline: Last session: Sensex slips 289 points as inflation concerns weigh on market sentiment

marketStatus.message: Market is closed today because it is a weekend. It will reopen on Tuesday, 17 November.

why: Inflation concerns weighed on investor sentiment in the last trading session.
Weak opening cues were signaled earlier by Gift Nifty.
Apparel exports grew 20% in October on currency depreciation, though volume growth remained subdued.
Under-utilisation of iron ore capacity in major-producing states prompted economic concerns.
whatHappening: On the last trading session, Sensex fell 289 points while Nifty slipped.
Despite the Friday decline, Nifty50 and Sensex extended their weekly rally for the third consecutive week.
PSU Banks emerged as the top sectoral gainers over the weekly period.
TRAI barred or disconnected over 1.24 lakh mobile connections during the July-September quarter.
summary: The Indian stock market is closed today due to the weekend. In the last trading session, Sensex fell 289 points as inflation concerns weighed on equities. However, markets completed a third consecutive week of overall gains led by PSU banks.
